item.title: Netflix's Award-winning Dark Sci-fi Series is Officially Returning
item.description: Get ready for more dystopian science fiction because an eighth season of TV series Black Mirror is in production for Netflix. Variety reports that the show began filming this summer, but has no confirmed release date. Series creator Charlie Brooker is back, and he will write and executive produce the series alongside Bisha K. Ali.

item.title: 6 Upcoming Sci-Fi Movies, Ranked by Hype
item.description: As studios double down on high-stakes bets, pouring absurd budgets into sprawling worlds and complex narratives like Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday , speculative fiction remains Hollywood’s ultimate proving ground for event-sized storytelling. To see what’s most exciting on the near horizon, here are the biggest upcoming sci-fi movies ranked by hype.

item.title: Marvel's Official Avengers: Doomsday Prep Launches on Nov. 18
item.description: The Marvel Cinematic Universe's next major event begins in December with the release of Avengers: Doomsday , which will be followed by Secret Wars next year. While trailers have only hinted at what these massive films will have in store for the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, and more, we know they are heavily inspired by the 2015 Secret Wars event comic . Now Marvel is returning to that era with a new limited series in the lead-up to Doomsday.

item.title: All 10 Zelda: Ocarina of Time Bosses, Ranked From Worst to Best
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time brought every great aspect back from the original version — including its iconic boss fights. From fire-breathing dragons to giant spiders to wicked witches, Ocarina of Time features a diverse lineup of boss battles that adds to every dungeon's unique charm, making this one of the best games in The Legend of Zelda series.

item.title: David Tennant Officially Returns to Doctor Who in 2027
item.description: The future of Doctor Who is uncertain, but at the very least, the universe has heard the pleas of fans who are in desperate need of more of David Tennant as the Tenth Doctor. That's right, there's even more time and space adventures for Tennant on the way, as he'll be reprising his role in a new audio drama from Big Finish — a British production company known for producing Doctor Who audio dramas and shorts .

item.title: Halo Defined a Generation of LAN Parties — Then It Killed Them
item.description: So old, in fact, that the upcoming 25th anniversary of the Xbox and Halo: Combat Evolved immediately made me think about the LAN parties my brother and I used to host in middle and high school. There were a dozen or so teenage boys, four TVs, and enough Ethernet cable to turn my parents’ house into a tripping hazard that could also burst into flames at any moment. I’ve played countless multiplayer games since, but none have come close to the majesty of those experiences.

item.title: Extremely Rare Pokémon Game Found 20 Years Later
item.description: PokéPark Fishing Rally DS was a 2005 temporary fishing game obtainable through Download Play on the Nintendo DS. To play it, gamers had to get it from Download Play stations at PokéPark in Nagoya, Japan. The game would remain on their console for 12 hours or until the console was shut off. After this, it would delete itself.

item.title: The 7 Best Star Wars: Galactic Racer Replacements You Can Play Right Now
item.description: Star Wars: Galactic Racer has no exact replicas, but there are plenty of obvious influences. Here are the best games like Star War: Galactic Racer.

item.title: 10 Most Underrated RPGs of the Past Decade
item.description: There’s something about RPGs. These games tell amazing stories players want to experience time and time again, are populated by memorable characters, and often explore deep themes — even if their heroes do tend to have memory problems, spiky hair, and swords the size of New Jersey.

item.title: 5 Brilliant Books To Read Before Kicking the Bucket
item.description: Also, tastes are subjective. Not everyone might jive with Great Expectations or Les Misérables despite their objective artistic merit. The definition of “must-read” has drastically changed over time. Keeping this in mind, Polygon has chosen five brilliant, indisputable books to read before kicking the bucket. Some are obvious picks, while others, not so much.
